crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
translations.asv: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
